   - "Ventricular system and basal cisterns are normal in size and configuration."
   - "Calvarium and skull base show no evidence of fracture line."
4. Impression Rules:
   - Non-verb summary stating exact pathology, location, mass effect/midline shift, and herniation risk.

=== AUTHORITATIVE RADIOLOGY CONSULTANT SKILL: MRI LUMBOSACRAL / CERVICAL / DORSAL SPINE ===
Archive Ground Truth & Phrasing Rules (2024-2026 Institutional Cases):
1. Normal Curvature & Alignment:
   - "The lumbosacral spine displays a normal lordotic curvature and normal vertebral column alignment."
   - "Screening of cervical spine shows focal reversal of lordosis from C3-C6 vertebrae."
2. Modic Changes & Vertebral Endplates:
   - Explicitly specify Modic type and signal characteristics: "Modic type 2 changes (hyperintense on both T1 and T2 weighted images) are seen involving the adjacent endplates of L5 and S1 vertebrae."
   - "Modic type 1 changes (hypointense on T1 and hyperintense on T2/STIR weighted images, suggestive of active inflammatory edema) are seen..."
3. Disc Pathology Staging & Level-by-Level Syntax:
   - Annular Tear: "Annular tear with pseudo bulge of L5-S1 disc causing bilateral neural foraminal narrowing and indenting bilateral exiting nerve roots."
   - Disc Desiccation: "There is loss of normal T2 hyperintensity of L4-L5 and L5-S1 discs suggestive of disc desiccation."
   - Posterior Concavity: "Loss of normal posterior concavity of L4-L5 disc is seen causing no significant mass effect."
   - Herniation Spectrum: "Diffuse annular disc bulge with central and left central disc extrusion with inferior migration is noted at L5-S1 level resulting in severe secondary canal narrowing, compression of left traversing nerve root and compression of the left half of the thecal sac and its contents."
   - Facet Arthropathy: "Mild to moderate bilateral facetal arthropathy is noted at L4-L5 and L5-S1 levels with ligamentum flavum thickening."
4. Listhesis & Spondylolysis:
   - "Grade 1 anterolisthesis of L5 over S1 with bilateral pars interarticularis defect (spondylolysis) causing unroofing of the disc, secondary canal narrowing and indenting bilateral exiting nerve roots."
5. Cord, Conus & Screenings:
   - "The conus medullaris ends at upper border of L1 and the cauda equina is normal in appearance."
   - "Screening of cervical spine shows bilateral uncovertebral joint arthropathy at C5-C6 causing bilateral neural foraminal narrowing."
   - "Screening of dorsal spine shows hemangioma of D10 and D11 vertebral bodies."
6. Impression Rules:
   - Non-verb, concise synthesis. Combine disc level, herniation type, canal narrowing grade, and exact nerve root compromise (traversing vs exiting).
   - "IMPRESSION:###Grade 1 anterolisthesis of L5 over S1 with bilateral spondylolysis, pseudo bulge and annular tear causing secondary canal narrowing and exiting nerve root indentation.###Diffuse disc bulge with left paracentral extrusion at L5-S1 causing severe canal stenosis and left traversing nerve root compression."

Archive Ground Truth & Phrasing Rules (2024-2026 Institutional Cases):
1. Normal Curvature & Alignment:
   - "The lumbosacral spine displays a normal lordotic curvature and normal vertebral column alignment."
   - "Screening of cervical spine shows focal reversal of lordosis from C3-C6 vertebrae."
2. Modic Changes & Vertebral Endplates:
   - Explicitly specify Modic type and signal characteristics: "Modic type 2 changes (hyperintense on both T1 and T2 weighted images) are seen involving the adjacent endplates of L5 and S1 vertebrae."
   - "Modic type 1 changes (hypointense on T1 and hyperintense on T2/STIR weighted images, suggestive of active inflammatory edema) are seen..."
3. Disc Pathology Staging & Level-by-Level Syntax:
   - Annular Tear: "Annular tear with pseudo bulge of L5-S1 disc causing bilateral neural foraminal narrowing and indenting bilateral exiting nerve roots."
   - Disc Desiccation: "There is loss of normal T2 hyperintensity of L4-L5 and L5-S1 discs suggestive of disc desiccation."
   - Posterior Concavity: "Loss of normal posterior concavity of L4-L5 disc is seen causing no significant mass effect."
   - Herniation Spectrum: "Diffuse annular disc bulge with central and left central disc extrusion with inferior migration is noted at L5-S1 level resulting in severe secondary canal narrowing, compression of left traversing nerve root and compression of the left half of the thecal sac and its contents."
   - Facet Arthropathy: "Mild to moderate bilateral facetal arthropathy is noted at L4-L5 and L5-S1 levels with ligamentum flavum thickening."
4. Listhesis & Spondylolysis:
   - "Grade 1 anterolisthesis of L5 over S1 with bilateral pars interarticularis defect (spondylolysis) causing unroofing of the disc, secondary canal narrowing and indenting bilateral exiting nerve roots."
5. Cord, Conus & Screenings:
   - "The conus medullaris ends at upper border of L1 and the cauda equina is normal in appearance."
   - "Screening of cervical spine shows bilateral uncovertebral joint arthropathy at C5-C6 causing bilateral neural foraminal narrowing."
   - "Screening of dorsal spine shows hemangioma of D10 and D11 vertebral bodies."
6. Impression Rules:
   - Non-verb, concise synthesis. Combine disc level, herniation type, canal narrowing grade, and exact nerve root compromise (traversing vs exiting).
   - "IMPRESSION:###Grade 1 anterolisthesis of L5 over S1 with bilateral spondylolysis, pseudo bulge and annular tear causing secondary canal narrowing and exiting nerve root indentation.###Diffuse disc bulge with left paracentral extrusion at L5-S1 causing severe canal stenosis and left traversing nerve root compression."

=== AUTHORITATIVE RADIOLOGY CONSULTANT SKILL: MRI LUMBOSACRAL / CERVICAL / DORSAL SPINE ===
Archive Ground Truth & Phrasing Rules (2024-2026 Institutional Cases):
1. Normal Curvature & Alignment:
   - "The lumbosacral spine displays a normal lordotic curvature and normal vertebral column alignment."
   - "Screening of cervical spine shows focal reversal of lordosis from C3-C6 vertebrae."
2. Modic Changes & Vertebral Endplates:
   - Explicitly specify Modic type and signal characteristics: "Modic type 2 changes (hyperintense on both T1 and T2 weighted images) are seen involving the adjacent endplates of L5 and S1 vertebrae."
   - "Modic type 1 changes (hypointense on T1 and hyperintense on T2/STIR weighted images, suggestive of active inflammatory edema) are seen..."
3. Disc Pathology Staging & Level-by-Level Syntax:
   - Annular Tear: "Annular tear with pseudo bulge of L5-S1 disc causing bilateral neural foraminal narrowing and indenting bilateral exiting nerve roots."
   - Disc Desiccation: "There is loss of normal T2 hyperintensity of L4-L5 and L5-S1 discs suggestive of disc desiccation."
   - Posterior Concavity: "Loss of normal posterior concavity of L4-L5 disc is seen causing no significant mass effect."
   - Herniation Spectrum: "Diffuse annular disc bulge with central and left central disc extrusion with inferior migration is noted at L5-S1 level resulting in severe secondary canal narrowing, compression of left traversing nerve root and compression of the left half of the thecal sac and its contents."
   - Facet Arthropathy: "Mild to moderate bilateral facetal arthropathy is noted at L4-L5 and L5-S1 levels with ligamentum flavum thickening."
4. Listhesis & Spondylolysis:
   - "Grade 1 anterolisthesis of L5 over S1 with bilateral pars interarticularis defect (spondylolysis) causing unroofing of the disc, secondary canal narrowing and indenting bilateral exiting nerve roots."
5. Cord, Conus & Screenings:
   - "The conus medullaris ends at upper border of L1 and the cauda equina is normal in appearance."
   - "Screening of cervical spine shows bilateral uncovertebral joint arthropathy at C5-C6 causing bilateral neural foraminal narrowing."
   - "Screening of dorsal spine shows hemangioma of D10 and D11 vertebral bodies."
6. Impression Rules:
   - Non-verb, concise synthesis. Combine disc level, herniation type, canal narrowing grade, and exact nerve root compromise (traversing vs exiting).
   - "IMPRESSION:###Grade 1 anterolisthesis of L5 over S1 with bilateral spondylolysis, pseudo bulge and annular tear causing secondary canal narrowing and exiting nerve root indentation.###Diffuse disc bulge with left paracentral extrusion at L5-S1 causing severe canal stenosis and left traversing nerve root compression."

Diffuse LGE of the LV papillary muscles also seen. No LV thrombus.  Lungs and mediastinum are normal.
(See graphs for BSA indexed LV values)

Conclusion | Early dilated LV with LVEF of 45%. Sub endocardial infarcts in basal inferior/ anterolateral segments, mid anterior wall/ septum/ inferior segment, entire apical cavity and apex.Focal mitral annular disjunction with mild prolapse of anterior mitral leaflet.CMR features are of ischemic early dilated cardiomyopathy. Of the 17 segments, 12 are viable and rest are normal.

Findings | Normal indexed LVEDV and LVESV with LVEF of 71%. Asymmetric hypertrophy of the LV is seen predominantly involving the anterior and anteroseptal segments with mid anterior segment measuring 22 mm in maximum end diastolic wall thickness. No SAM of the anterior mitral leaflet/ narrowing of the LVOT is seen. No regional wall motion abnormality is seen.The RV is normal in appearance with preserved systolic function. No RV hypertrophy. Enlarged right paratracheal and subcarinal lymph nodes are seen measuring 14 mm in short axis.
(See graphs for BSA indexed LV values)

Indication | Known DVD with borderline LAD. For ischemia assessment.

   - Annular Tear: "Annular tear with pseudo bulge of L5-S1 disc causing bilateral neural foraminal narrowing and indenting bilateral exiting nerve roots."
   - Disc Desiccation: "There is loss of normal T2 hyperintensity of L4-L5 and L5-S1 discs suggestive of disc desiccation."
   - Posterior Concavity: "Loss of normal posterior concavity of L4-L5 disc is seen causing no significant mass effect."
   - Herniation Spectrum: "Diffuse annular disc bulge with central and left central disc extrusion with inferior migration is noted at L5-S1 level resulting in severe secondary canal narrowing, compression of left traversing nerve root and compression of the left half of the thecal sac and its contents."

4. Listhesis & Spondylolysis:
   - "Grade 1 anterolisthesis of L5 over S1 with bilateral pars interarticularis defect (spondylolysis) causing unroofing of the disc, secondary canal narrowing and indenting bilateral exiting nerve roots."

name: # Tc99m Stress MPI
title: Stress Myocardial Perfusion Scintigraphy
lines: Stress SPECT myocardial perfusion scintigraphy was performed after intravenous injection of standard dose of Tc99m Sestamibi. Physical stress was performed using modified Bruce Protocol on treadmill.
Baseline Heart Rate and BP:   / min, / mm Hg
Maximum Heart Rate Achieved:   / min, (<85% of MPHR)
The LV cavity appears normal in size in the post stress images.
No tracer uptake is seen in lungs and right ventricle.
All segments of myocardium demonstrate normal perfusion at stress.
All segments of the myocardium demonstrate normal wall motion and normal thickening.
Summed stress score (SSS) is 0 (demonstrates ischemia or infarct)
SCORING AND QUALITATIVE DEFINITIONS FOLLOWED IN THE REPORTING  FORMAT:
Cumulative scores are taken from all 17 segments at stress and rest.
17 segments are scored from 0 to 4 with 0 = normal perfusion, 1= mild decrease in perfusion, 2 = moderate decrease in perfusion, 3 =severe decrease in perfusion and 4 = absent perfusion).
Small: equal to or less than 2 segments, moderate size: 3 or 4 segments; large size is > 4 segments involved.

The perfusion defect size may be quantitatively described as small, medium or large. Small defect represents less than 10%, medium 10-20% and large represents greater than or equal 20% of the LV myocardium.
Mild grade: not normal but > 70 % perfusion maintained
Absent perfusion: less than 30 % perfusion maintained.
This scoring is also used in Bulls Eye evaluation.

The defect severity is expressed visually as mild, moderate or severe. A mild defect is identified by a decrease count compared to the adjacent wall with preserved thickness, moderate defect demonstrate wall thinning and severe defect appears similar to background activity.
ALL SEGMENTS DEMONSTRATE NORMAL PERFUSION AT STRESS WITH NO EVIDENCE OF INDUCIBLE ISCHEMIA.
